meta.description: Promote 4,000+ brands, turn your audience or traffic into income, and get fast local-currency payouts. Free to join — grow with Involve Asia.

hero.title: Feature a whole catalogue, without collecting it by hand.
hero.sub: Datafeed hands you an advertiser’s full product list in one file, names, prices, images, and more, so you can feature as many products as you want without gathering each one yourself.
hero.imageAlt: A product list synced to a site through Involve Datafeed

what.title: What is Involve Datafeed?
what.sub: A datafeed is a ready-made file of an advertiser’s products, with the details you need to feature them: product name, price, product URL, image, description, and category. Instead of adding products one by one, you get the whole catalogue at once, then add your own tracking so the sales are credited to you.
what.imageAlt: A grid of an advertiser's products ready to feature through Involve Datafeed

how.title: How it works
items: Browse the datafeed and pick the advertiser whose products you want to feature.
Download the product feed and that advertiser’s step-by-step guide.
Follow the guide to add your tracking to the product links, so your clicks and sales are credited to you.

manual.title: The manual way
items: Find each product and copy its title and image from the brand’s site.
Generate an affiliate link for it.

involve.sub: Get the catalogue in one file. Add your tracking once, then feature as many products as you like.
items: Download the brand’s product feed, the whole catalogue in one file.
Add your tracking to the feed’s product links, following the brand’s guide, once per brand.
Publish the products on your site.
